usedFor: Moneybird holds quotes and invoices and Sangam CRM tracks the pipeline, so “New Quote” can open an opportunity with “Create Opportunity”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Quote” in Moneybird, then “Create Opportunity” in Sangam CRM
bestTemplate.why: A quote sent means a deal is live, and the action records it with a next follow-up date.

watchOut: “New Quote” and “New Invoice” can each fire “Create Opportunity”, so one deal may be opened twice.
